messages:
incident-bot: :warning: PAGER // prod-inference - elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (text-gen) detected. Severity: high. Paging primary oncall. Monitor: https://monitoring.redwood/prod-inference

priya: ack, i'm oncall and taking this. creating bridge and adding runtime + infra. bridge: https://zoom.company/bridges/2987

alex: joining bridge. quick check: are embeddings impacted?

emily: embeddings look OK from metrics. only text-gen endpoints have spikes. pulling last 45m logs now.

tom: support queue shows 9 error reports in last 30m, including one P1-B customer reporting 500s for bulk requests.

priya: initial mitigation plan: 1) reroute heavy tenants to mem-lean variant (v1-smallmem) 2) apply per-request kv limit 3) scale worker pool + limit concurrency. executing step 1 now.

alex: applying routing override: `rctl traffic override --svc prod-inference --variant v1-smallmem --pct 100 --reason "reduce OOMs"`
devops-bot: routing override recorded: override-id=ovr-20260315-01 by alex at 1800456834

emily: logs show repeated worker OOMs around 1800456600. sample:

```
2026-03-15T04:30:00Z worker-9 ERROR OOM when allocating 1.5GB for kv_cache
2026-03-15T04:30:01Z worker-9 INFO exit pid=11203
2026-03-15T04:30:02Z lb WARN connection reset -> 500
```

kevin: CS note: P1-B onlines us via phone, wants ETA and whether retries caused duplicate billing. Support: please flag billing team if retries were applied.

priya: quick config check - no runtime deploy in last 48h. But there was a kernel-selection experiment toggled yesterday at ~02:00 UTC (tom you might have flagged).
tom: yep, kernel-select flag was enabled for 30% traffic yesterday for perf testing. Could be related.

emily: token-length analysis coming: if longer prompts are causing big kv-cache, that'll explain OOMs. pulling per-tenant token stats now.

incident-bot: auto-check scheduled: re-evaluate 5xx after 2m. Alert if >10% above baseline.

priya: hypotheses (ranked):
- H1: sudden shift to longer input sequences from one tenant -> kv-cache pressure -> OOMs.
- H2: kernel-select path increases memory overhead under concurrent batches -> OOM regression.
- H3: new allocator/GC heuristics interacting with batch sizing -> leak under load.

alex: to validate H1, we need token-length histograms for last 3h and top offending tenants. emily: ETA?
emily: have initial histograms: tenant P1-B median tokens jumped from 280 -> 950 in last 90m. others mostly stable. attaching summarized numbers in a follow-up.

priya: drafting status page copy now. short + actionable.

support: STATUS DRAFT v1:
"We are investigating elevated errors impacting text generation endpoints. A routing change has been applied to shift traffic to a lower-memory model while we scale capacity and investigate the root cause. Some customers with high-throughput or long inputs may see increased errors or degraded performance. Estimated time to recovery: up to 60 minutes. Contact support@redwood.ai for urgent issues and see live updates at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1800456789"

kevin: add line: "P1-B has been contacted by CS; billing concerns are being reviewed."

priya: assigning tasks in-thread:
- @alex: verify routing override, monitor qps -> errors, and enable short TTL on route (ETA 10m)
- @emily: continue log aggregation + produce token histogram per-tenant (ETA 8m)
- @oncall-rotation: scale worker pool + confirm autoscaler reacted (ETA 15m)
- @support: post status draft and notify P1-B (ETA 10m)

alex: routing override applied, confirmed traffic shifting. errors down ~55% in first 3m but still above baseline. will add short TTL 2m on override.

oncall-rotation: scaled pool +25% at 1800456989. new workers reporting healthy.

emily: token histograms: P1-B heavy-tail: 75th=1200, median=920, baseline-median=300. Others within expected ranges. exporting CSV for postmortem.

priya: next mitigation: per-request cap to reduce peak kv allocation. Alex, can you deploy a canary with kv_cap=300MB?
alex: creating canary patch branch and will push to 10% of workers. `git commit -m "hotfix: per-request kv cap 300MB"` running CI. ETA 18m to full roll if canary stable.

emily: after routing + scale, OOMs still happening but limited to unpatched workers. canary workers show no OOMs under synthetic regen tests.

support: status posted at 1800456925 (public). CS notified P1-B.

kevin: received call from P1-B; they are rate-limiting their clients temporarily. they want a follow-up once root cause known.

priya: operational timeline (working):
- 1800456600: monitoring anomalies begin
- 1800456608: first worker OOMs observed in logs
- 1800456789: incident-bot pager fired (this thread)
- 1800456834: routing override applied -> v1-smallmem
- 1800456890: autoscaler scale +25% started
- 1800456925: status page posted & P1-B notified
- 1800456989: new workers registered
- 1800457060: canary kv_cap=300MB deployed to subset
- 1800457140: canary shows no OOMs, proceed with roll

priya: communications plan for stakeholders: who: ops lead, eng head, product; when: 30m post-mitigation; what: brief impact summary, mitigations, ETA for full recovery; mode: email + slack DM. Sam from product will own email (assigning to support in-thread).

support: stakeholder email draft in thread:
Subject: Incident: Text-gen 5xx spike impacting subset of customers (summary + mitigations)
Body (short): We detected elevated 5xx errors on text generation endpoints affecting a small number of high-throughput customers. Mitigations applied: traffic rerouted to lower-memory model, worker pool scaled, hotfix to cap per-request KV allocation being rolled. Estimated full recovery within 60 minutes; we will provide a technical timeline and RCA once available. Contact: support@redwood.ai.

alex: rolling kv_cap patch to all workers now. monitoring closely.
emily: post-roll logs show no new OOMs in last 12m on patched workers. residual 5xx due to in-flight requests on older workers draining.

oncall-rotation: autoscaler normalized at 1800457800; pool stable.

priya: status update 1800458000: errors down ~90% vs peak. routing override TTL will remain until postmortem and validation of kernel-select flag.

priya: RCA notes to capture later: tenant input distribution change, kernel-selection experiment correlation, default kv_cache sizing, and routing TTL policies. also capture customer-impact window and ticket IDs for P1-B.

emily: I'll attach CSVs, OOM stack traces, and memory graphs to the postmortem doc.

support: will follow up with P1-B once postmortem ready; keeping status page updated.

priya: closing live bridge in 40m if stable. keeping this thread as single source for timeline + comms drafts; move to async RCA channel after bridge closes. tag me for urgent follow-ups.

incident-bot: INCIDENT [1800456789] mitigation: in-progress. next automated check at 1800458400.
